meta.title: Edit name and profile picture in My profile

plan.title: Edit My Profile Name and Picture

args.goal: Hover over the User Profile icon, open My profile, press Edit, change the user's Name and profile picture, press Save, and stop when the profile panel or profile sub-menu visibly shows the updated name and picture.

steps.note: Handles the profile-specific navigation, editing controls, upload, save action, and verification that are not represented by dedicated catalog steps.
Confirms the profile context remains visible after saving.
